thread:
Alex: FYI — finished the seasonal failure-signature scan for the last 90 days. posting top signals and proposed owners.
Priya: awesome, curious which signals are new vs recurring.
Alex: quick snapshot — recurring cluster: oom/model memory growth, nvlink flaps on p4x, and rollout flakiness during canaries. percentages under.
Alex: ```Top signals (90d):
- model OOM / cache blowup: 29%
- nvlink/transient PCI errors: 18%
- canary rollback / bad prompt weight: 13%
- network egress throttling (spikes): 11%
- autoscaler contention during spikes: 9%
- other (disk, infra): 20%
```
Marta: thanks. do we have ownership for each bucket? I can take OOMs / cache behavior.
Alex: yes, suggested owners: OOMs -> Marta (eng-sre), nvlink -> Sam (infra-hw), canary rollbacks -> Priya (platform), autoscale -> Jonathan (runtime). I left timelines too.
Priya: timeline request: are we looking hotfix (2w) vs medium (6w) vs long (Q)?
Alex: suggested: OOMs hotfix (2w) + follow-up config changes (6w). nvlink investigation (1w triage, hardware swap 4w). canary policy tweak (3d) + rollout safety (2w). autoscaler tuning (6w).
Sam: I can start nvlink triage tomorrow. will open a hardware ticket and ping infra ops.
oncall-bot: Created INC-4739 for nvlink triage, assigned to Sam.
Marta: starting memory trace runbook today. will post traces + repro in #eng-runtime. owner: Marta, due: 2026-04-08 (hotfix), 2026-04-28 (config follow-up).
Priya: I'll draft a canary-safety checklist and add automated rollback thresholds. aiming EOD Friday.
Jonathan: autoscaler: I'll run a spike sim this week and share a tuning PR. target 2 sprints for rollout.
Alex: action summary (short):
- INC-4738 OOM sigs — owner: Marta — hotfix 2w / config 6w
- INC-4739 nvlink triage — owner: Sam — triage 1w / swap 4w
- PR-xxxx canary checklist — owner: Priya — draft 3d / rollout 2w
- Autoscaler tuning RFC — owner: Jonathan — spike this week / 2 sprint rollout
- Monitoring: add signature alerts + weekly digest (owner: Alex)
Alex: will consolidate into the monthly incident-pattern board and ping owners for status checks every Tues.
Priya: can we link the heatmap and a short query? saves repetition.
Alex: link: https://internal.redwood/sys/heatmaps/seasonal-90d (private). query we used: ```SELECT sig, count(*) FROM incidents WHERE ts > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY sig ORDER BY count DESC```
Sam: noted, I'll attach hw logs to INC-4739 once triage starts.
Marta: quick ask — can we prioritize a small telemetry patch to capture kv-cache sizes at allocation? that will help OOM root cause.
Alex: good call. adding telemetry patch as a hot item under INC-4738.
Jonathan: tagging in the weekly ops review to surface cross-team deps. @Priya @Marta please add any blockers.
Priya: added blocker: need a staging run with traffic mirror to validate canary thresholds.
Alex: ok, adding that to the board and marking owner Priya, blocker flag.
Marta: will update traces + ETA in 24h.
Sam: starting nvlink swap window scheduling; will coordinate with infra ops.
oncall-bot: Reminder: recurring-pattern-checks weekly digest scheduled for Tue 09:00.
Alex: thanks everyone. I'll post the consolidated action card (with tickets + due dates) by EOD and we can track in the postmortem follow-ups column. :thumbsup:
